close_reason: Superseded by PKIX-lwr9.6, which both wired the harness AND regenerated the baseline + analysis as a single integrated change. baseline-limbo.json, baseline-limbo-allfeatures.json, and baseline-limbo-analysis.md are all updated and committed (2026-05-11). description:
## Why

After PKIX-lwr9.2/.3/.4 land, the x509-limbo Tier-2 baseline needs re-running to confirm the 43 SUCCESS-expected bettertls::pathbuilding cases flip from StricterThanWild to Agreement(Pass), and to surface any cases that did NOT flip (those become follow-up beads).

## What

1. Run `cargo run --release -p pkix-difftest -- run limbo ~/GIT/x509-limbo/limbo.json --oracles pkix-path,openssl,pyca --output-md pkix-difftest/baseline-limbo.md --output-json pkix-difftest/baseline-limbo.json` after .2/.3/.4 close.
2. Verify the StricterThanWild count drops from 74 toward ~30 (the expected residual: tc8/tc15 outliers + the 4 online::* P-384 cases + ~24 webpki:: P-384/Ed25519/PSS cases, all of which are crypto-feature limitations not path-builder issues).
3. Update `pkix-difftest/baseline-limbo-analysis.md` to reflect the new bucket counts and confirm which residual cases require which crypto features (tracked under PKIX-wmch).
4. If any bettertls::pathbuilding case did NOT flip, file a follow-up bead under PKIX-lwr9 (e.g., PKIX-lwr9.6) documenting the residual failure mode. Acceptance per PKIX-lwr9: residual non-flips are filed as follow-ups, not failure of the umbrella.

## Acceptance

- [ ] baseline-limbo.{json,md} regenerated and committed.
- [ ] baseline-limbo-analysis.md updated with new counts.
- [ ] StricterThanWild count drops by ~43 (target ~31 residual).
- [ ] Any residual bettertls::pathbuilding non-flips have follow-up beads filed.

## Depends on

PKIX-lwr9.2, PKIX-lwr9.3, PKIX-lwr9.4.

## Filed by

PKIX-lwr9 decomposition decision 2026-05-11 (Mark).
